title: ISO 9001 Foundation
overview: The ISO 9001 Foundation course provides an introduction to the ISO 9001 standard for Quality Management Systems (QMS). This course covers the fundamental principles and requirements of ISO 9001, including the structure of the standard and its application in establishing and maintaining an effective quality management system. It prepares participants to understand ISO 9001 requirements and supports their preparation for the ISO 9001 Foundation certification exam.
audience: Quality managers and quality assurance professionals.
Process owners and team leaders involved in quality management.
Individuals responsible for implementing and maintaining quality management systems.
Professionals seeking to gain foundational knowledge in ISO 9001.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Detailed explanation of ISO 9001 principles, requirements, and processes.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises to apply ISO 9001 concepts.
Case Studies: Analysis of real-world scenarios and application of ISO 9001 principles.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore quality management challenges and solutions.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate understanding and readiness for the certification exam.
competencies: Quality management system structure and processes
Continuous improvement and risk management in quality management
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a thorough understanding of the ISO 9001 standard and its requirements.
To develop skills for implementing and maintaining a quality management system based on ISO 9001.
To prepare participants for the ISO 9001 Foundation certification exam.
To equip participants with techniques for ensuring quality and continuous improvement in their organization.
